coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Approximately 5 of 18 ground-truth variable items match (28%): full dynamic lookup, no lookup, mean key-vector representation, QA tasks, and A100 hardware. The QA and hardware matches are broad rather than exact reproductions.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output proposes a substantially different experiment. It omits decoding-only lookup and the representative-token baseline, substitutes different model versions and benchmarks, and changes fp16 to bfloat16. It does not preserve the required 4K window, 96 selected units, 512-token chunks, 128 initial tokens, 12K context, or four representative tokens per 128-token unit. Shared seed/configuration controls and accuracy (%) on the specified tasks are not reproduced; numerous unrelated factors and metrics are added.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It provides no finding about the benefit of full memory lookup, the near-collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or the advantage of representative tokens over mean representations.
